title: Willow Beach Kayak, SUP or Canoe Full Day Rental
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Weight limit 300lbs for single / 500lbs for tandem rentals
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the Colorado River’s scenic Black Canyon with flexible, 1-day water vessel rentals at Willow Beach, located less than an hour from Las Vegas. Choose from top-quality kayaks, paddleboards, or canoes equipped with all essential gear, perfect for paddling to the famous Emerald Cave, spotting local wildlife, and discovering hidden beaches. Ideal for families, solo paddlers, and groups of all skill levels, this self-guided adventure includes personalized launch support for a seamless day on the water.
